violation_type.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training (26 TAC §747.801(3))
violation_type.short_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training
violation_type.typical_finding: The primary caregiver has still not completed the required trainings for the last training year.

finding_variants.text: The primary caregiver has still not completed the required trainings for the last training year.
The primary caregiver's annual training hours for the previous training year (2/2023 - 2/2024) were not available for review at the time of inspection.
Two out of two staff had no trainings availalbe for review during the visit.
Trainings for the health and safety audit were not available for review.
The provider did not have the personnel file and training records available for review during the inspection. This includes herself and one staff person.
Personnel and training records were not available for review for the primary caregiver or the 3 substitute and assistant caregivers.
